name: Wiit S.p.A.
summary: Wiit S.p.A. provides cloud services for various businesses in Italy and internationally. It offers hybrid, hosted private, and public cloud services; cloud services for critical applications; business continuity and disaster recovery services; cyber security solutions; managed services; system integration services; and cloud management solutions services. The company also provides colocation, managed hosting, standardized hosting, and IT outsourcing services, as well as ERP software solutions, server virtualization, installation of hyperconverged infrastructure, storage systems, and network infrastructure development services.
